title: Citation Grounding for Scientific Retrieval
summary: We study retrieval-augmented scientific literature review systems with citation grounding, latency measurements, and abstention behavior.

title: Operational Uncertainty in Scientific Machine Learning
summary: This paper evaluates calibration, uncertainty communication, and risk controls for neural models used in scientific decision support.

title: Anomaly Detection for Observatory Instrumentation
summary: We compare machine learning baselines for anomaly detection in astronomical instrumentation telemetry and observatory operations.
